+++ /private/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/opencode-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T014328Z/skill-state-v3/mini-template/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+Supported tags:
+
+- `{{path.to.value}}` for HTML-escaped interpolation
+- `{{{path.to.value}}}` for raw interpolation
+- `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` for conditionals
+- `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` for array iteration
+- `{{this}}`, `{{this.path}}`, and `{{@index}}` inside loops
+- `{{! comment }}` for comments
+
+Run the CLI with a UTF-8 template and JSON data file:
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts template.txt data.json
+```
+
+Run the self-tests with `bun test`.
